thread:
Nina R.: Quick handoff for HarborEdge (fintech). Closed today: 40 seats, Dedicated + VPC, 21-day on-prem eval. They require EU data residency and encrypted audit logs. Billing unusual: customer asked for NET45 payment terms (finance needs approval). Deal doc: https://paper.example/harboredge-3344. Can CS take it?

Omar V.: Thanks Nina  I'll take lead. Owners: onboarding = Omar V.; provisioning/infra = Devon P.; support/runbook = Leah M.; security/compliance = Priya S.; billing follow-up = Nina R. (sales) + billing-bot.

Nina R.: Primary customer contact is Mateo R. (Platform). He wants a sandbox asap to validate SSO and the logging pipeline. Also asked if we can limit data egress to EU regions only during eval.

Leah M.: Support note: need expected steady qps and peak. Also confirm whether embeddings will be stored in our managed vector DB or their S3. Will create ticket HEDGE-3344 in Zendesk.

Devon P.: Eng ask: expected traffic, sequence lengths, and whether on-prem eval needs our diagnostic collector. If EU residency required, we need to confirm infra region and replication. I'll open GH issue rwinf/ops#3344 and tag infra/region.

Omar V.: Estimates from sales: baseline ~25 r/s, bursts to 100 r/s for reports. Typical prompt size ~1200 tokens. Embeddings used for search; customer prefers them stored in customer-controlled S3 (EU). Marking account health: green -> monitor first 30d. Renewal note: they asked about price protection; flag as renewal-watch for month 8.

Priya S.: Security: HarborEdge requests HSM-backed keys in prod and KMS acceptable for eval. Also need to confirm whether they require PBKDF2 or RSA-based cert exchanges for mTLS. I'll coordinate with SecOps.

Nina R.: I'll push billing for NET45 approval and loop finance. Also adding a clause request: 10% cap on price increases for first renewal period  flagging for legal.

Leah M.: Ticket HEDGE-3344 created: https://zendesk.example/tickets/91011. Assigned to Leah M. I'll paste comms checklist and ask for SAML XML + allowlist + S3 ARN. Initial payload I put in ticket: 
```
POST /provision
{ "acct": "HEDGE-3344", "env": "sandbox", "vpc": true, "mTLS": true, "region": "eu-west-1", "embeddings_storage": "customer-s3" }
```

Devon P.: GH issue rwinf/ops#3344 opened. Items on my list: region isolation plan, on-prem eval checklist (data deletion + audit logs), and capacity plan for 100 r/s peak with 2048 token windows. Tagging runtime/replication.

Priya S.: SecOps follow-up: HSM in prod is doable but lead time ~6 weeks. For eval we'll provision KMS keys scoped to EU and provide audit report. Also need customer to sign the on-prem evaluator access form.

Omar V.: Scheduling kickoff with HarborEdge for Thu 10am CET. Agenda: success criteria, SSO plan, data residency flow, POC schedule (21d), and invoicing timeline. Will capture success metrics: inference latency p50 < 300ms, search recall > 0.9 on provided test set.

billing-bot: Billing request submitted: NET45 approval needed (https://billing.example/requests/3344). Finance owner: @Priya S. tagged for review.

Nina R.: I'll stay on for two weeks to help smooth the handoff. Mateo confirmed Thu 10am CET works and will provide SAML + S3 ARN beforehand.

Leah M.: Action items summary posted to ticket and internal tracker: 
- Omar: kickoff + success criteria capture (owner: Omar V.)
- Devon: infra provisioning + GH issue (owner: Devon P.)
- Leah: support runbook + Zendesk ticket (owner: Leah M.)
- Priya: SecOps + HSM/KMS plan (owner: Priya S.)
- Nina: billing/legal follow-up on NET45 and price-cap (owner: Nina R.)

Omar V.: I'll update the deal doc with owners and timelines and link back to this thread. Ping me if anything missing. :thumbsup:
